t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try to make note of the colour basket in relation to the best multipliers, and select that colour basket each time for higher multiplies and therefore higher overall points

vb_textbox.text: The red, brown, pink and purple gnomes all give you a red basket. The blue, orange, green and yellow gnomes give you a yellow basket. If you select a gnome with a yellow basket on a 5x mulitplier you will get more mushrooms
